name: Volume Deformation via Scattered Data Interpolation
aliases: Scattered Data Interpolation for Volume Deformation
definition: A method for deforming volumetric objects based on user-guided scattered data interpolation. It reduces the complexity of manipulating millions of voxels by guiding 3D deformation from a user-defined 2D illustration, using scattered data interpolation to build a 2D displacement map which is then extruded into a 3D displacement map.
summary: This method deforms volumes by interpolating sparse 2D user handles into a global 3D displacement map, differing from local transformations by using smooth, global interpolation.
